subject: 小昭寺 · 主殿正立面（现状，三层红墙与金顶）
name: 小昭寺
sub: 主殿正立面 · 吐蕃创建 · 1986年重修
yearNote: 相传641年（藏历铁牛年）由文成公主奠基；原殿毁于火，1474年重建为三层殿并成为上密院集会殿；1959年再遭火毁，1986年完成重建。所绘为现状正立面，年表取国保名单所记的641年创建，不把现存三层主殿认作吐蕃原构。
place: 西藏 · 拉萨 · 小昭寺路
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q1853679（小昭寺）P625 坐标 29.65861, 91.13056（精度1″），寺院本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；复用既有地图显示点 xz_lhasa（大昭寺附近，相距约1公里）。
lede: 与大昭寺并称“拉萨二昭”。相传641年文成公主奠基，供奉她带来的释迦牟尼八岁等身像。原殿毁于火，1474年重建为三层并成为上密院所在；1959年再度火毁，1986年大修至今。今天的正立面是三层红墙，一、二层的木构窗廊层层退收，顶上一座金顶、四根宝幢。
facts: 年代：相传641年（藏历铁牛年）由文成公主奠基；原殿毁于火，1474年重建为三层殿，成为上密院的集会殿；2001年列第五批国保。
形制：寺占地约4000平方米，主殿三层，正立面以红墙为主，一、二层设木构窗廊，顶层女儿墙上为鎏金金顶与法轮双鹿、宝幢。
重修：1959年被大火焚毁，1962年列自治区文保单位，1986年完成重建；殿内释迦牟尼八岁等身像的上下两半据称于1983年分别在北京和拉萨寻回。
caption: 小昭寺 · 主殿正立面
吐蕃创建 · 1986年重修
structure_checkpoints: 正立面为深红色三层主殿：中段较宽，两侧各一座略凸的红色塔楼状体量，塔楼每层一窗（黑色窗套、金色格栅、白色短檐）。
中段自下而上四带：底层黑底金纹门帘覆盖柱廊入口（八宝、法轮双鹿纹样）；一层白色布幔与红蓝相间的帘带，木构格栅窗廊；二层黄色帘带与红帘带，木构窗廊；顶部深红边玛墙。
屋顶：女儿墙正中一座小型鎏金金顶立法轮双鹿；女儿墙两端各立两只鎏金宝幢圆筒与一个宝瓶形刹——合计四筒、两刹，另在两塔楼顶各有鎏金圆饰；整体平顶、墙体收分。
底层两侧红墙各开一方窗；立面左右为相邻的白墙民居与红墙侧殿，图版只取主殿本体。
material_observations: 主殿墙面深红色抹灰；窗套黑色、窗格金色；门帘黑底金纹；幔帐白色、黄色与红蓝条纹；金顶、宝幢、法轮鎏金；台地与广场灰色石板。
author: Gerd Eichmann

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the main hall of Ramoche Temple (小昭寺), Lhasa, straight-on front elevation as in Image 2 (Image 3 is the same view for checking details). Draw the complete three-storey hall: a broad central section flanked by two slightly projecting tower-like end bays, each end bay with one framed lattice window per storey under a short valance. Central section, bottom to top: a ground-floor entrance loggia covered by a wide banner carrying simple emblem outlines; a first-floor timber window gallery under a hanging cloth band; a second-floor timber window gallery under another cloth band; a deep plain parapet on top. On the parapet: a small gilded roof at the centre with a dharma wheel between two deer, and at each end TWO cylindrical banner finials plus one slender vase-shaped finial (four cylinders and two spires in total), with a small round ornament on each end tower. Walls lean slightly inward; flat roof; two small windows in the ground-floor wall beside the loggia. Do not draw the neighbouring white houses, potted trees, vehicles, people, railings or signboards.
Orientation: landscape 1536×1024.
